_doc: Era feel outside battle (docs/ERA_FEEL_UI.md), read by scripts/core/EraFeel.gd through EraManager.feel(). One entry per era I-V; every era sets every key in EraFeel.KEYS. Era I is the game as it was before this table (nothing removed); every later era keeps all of it and adds its own step, the way handheld generations added colour, then a richer palette and reflections, then a tilted 2.5D view, then moving figures and a moving camera. palette: UI colours paper, ink, mid, accent, disabled. frame: UITheme frame kind. font: pixel or large. text_cps_mult: typing speed factor. blip: text voice sound. bar: Vigor bar style in menus. warp: door or iris. town_popup: place-name banner style. water_shimmer, flower_sway, grass_fx, reflections, footprints, season_tint, idle_breathe: overworld extras (on from that era). walk_frames: 2 = stand and step, 3 = left and right foot. tilt: perspective strength of the overworld (0 = flat top-down). camera_lead: pixels the camera looks ahead while walking. levels: colour levels per channel that stand for this era's look when the era-change sequence shows it as the old look (0 = the Era I inks). upgrade: style of the era-change sequence into this era. jingle: sound of that sequence. title and caption: the one-line caption, English (German in tools/i18n/de_era_feel.py).

1.title: Era I - Ink
1.caption: A map drawn in four inks.

2.title: Era II - Wash
2.caption: The ink runs. The world fills with colour!

3.title: Era III - Etching
3.caption: The air grows clearer. Every leaf shows more detail!

4.title: Era IV - Panorama
4.caption: The map unrolls wider than ever before!

5.title: Era V - Living
5.caption: The map breathes. The world is alive!
